verdict.rationale: The official Lium CLI README includes a file-copy-to-pod command, which is the product's own transfer tooling. The evidence is a single comment line, though, with no detail on direction (out of the pod), throughput, or bulk transfer. Persistent Volumes mounted at /mnt and local-volume backups concern storage and restore rather than moving data in or out, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync (S3/GCS/etc.), documented copy-out/download path, transfer-tooling depth (rsync, resumable or bulk transfer), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can move data in and out efficiently — S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, or documented transfer tooling
